title: DSpark: Confidence-Scheduled Speculative Decoding with Semi-Autoregressive Generation
author: Xin Cheng; Xingkai Yu; Chenze Shao; Jiashi Li; Yunfan Xiong; Yi Qian; Jiaqi Zhu; Shirong Ma; Xiaokang Zhang; Jiasheng Ye; Qinyu Chen; Chengqi Deng; Jiping Yu; Damai Dai; Zhengyan Zhang; Yixuan Wei; Yixuan Tan; Wenkai Yang; Runxin Xu; Yu Wu; Zhean ...
summary: DSpark speeds up language model generation by using a smart draft model to guess tokens and a target model to check them efficiently. It improves on past methods by reducing wasted work on unlikely token guesses. This approach lowers the time needed to generate text without losing accuracy.
